Plot Prediction-Powered Inference vs. Human-Only & Naive LLM Benchmarks

Source: R/autoplot.R
autoplot.llm_ppi.Rd

Produces a publication-ready forest plot comparing parameter point estimates and confidence intervals across Naive LLM, Human-Only, and PPI / PPI++, optionally overlaying true simulation values.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'llm_ppi'
autoplot(
  object,
  terms = NULL,
  include_intercept = FALSE,
  true_values = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An "llm_ppi" object returned by ppi_mean(), ppi_lm(), ppi_glm(), ppi_clustered(), or ppi_lmer().

terms

Optional character vector restricting displayed model terms.

include_intercept

Logical; whether to display "(Intercept)" when other regression predictors are present. Default FALSE.

true_values

Optional named numeric vector of ground-truth parameter values to overlay as vertical dashed reference lines (useful for simulation diagnostics).

...

Unused; included for S3 consistency.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object.

Examples

set.seed(123)
n_tot <- 500
x <- rnorm(n_tot)
y_true <- 1 + 1.5 * x + rnorm(n_tot)
y_llm <- 0.5 + 0.8 * y_true + 0.5 * x + rnorm(n_tot, sd = 0.5)
df <- tibble::tibble(
  x = x,
  human_y = c(y_true[1:100], rep(NA_real_, n_tot - 100)),
  llm_y = y_llm
)
fit <- ppi_lm(human_y ~ x, data = df, pred_col = "llm_y")
autoplot(fit)
